title: Prove installed guard applicability after release
text: Candidate tests cover unrelated main commits, destructive Git, privacy and unmatched globs; registered projects, subdirectories, worktrees, nested independent Git repos and authenticated remote identity. Installed Claude, Codex and Cursor delivery after release is not yet proved; source tests do not imply live verification. Candidate lifecycle safety tests now cover config failures and bounded Stop holds; installed Claude, Codex and Cursor delivery of those warnings and brakes still needs release proof.
